headline: V. Srinivasa Rangan re-appointed as Executive Director for one year
why: Continuity in senior leadership overseeing key corporate functions for another year.

people.name: V. Srinivasa Rangan
people.background: Aged 66, holds a B.Com from University of Delhi and is an Associate of ICAI. Formerly Executive Director & CFO of HDFC Limited prior to its amalgamation with the Bank, with vast experience in housing finance, real estate, finance, and risk management.
